The '''LCK 2016 Spring''' was the first split of the 2016 [[League of Legends Champions Korea]] season, organized by Riot Games in partnership with OnGameNet. The split took place in Seoul, South Korea, from January 13 to April 23, 2016, and featured ten teams. Unlike the previous year, this split did not include a title sponsor, marking the end of the SBENU partnership that had covered both 2015 splits.

The regular season followed a Double Round Robin format with Best-of-Three matches, while the Playoffs used a Single Elimination King of the Hill structure with Best-of-Five series. Teams competed for a ₩275,000,000 KRW prize pool, with the winner qualifying for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2016|2016 Mid-Season Invitational]]. [[Longzhu Gaming]] and [[SBENU Sonicboom]] joined the league through the [[LCK/2016/Spring/Promotion|2016 Spring Promotion Tournament]]. Matches were played primarily on Patches 5.24 through 6.6.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place''}} advance to the Finals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th and 6th place''}} advance to the Wild Card Round of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 8th place''}} qualify for [[LCK/2016/Summer|Summer split]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th and 10th place''}} will have to play in the [[LCK/2016/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]].
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination King of the Hill.
*** Wild Card match is {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
*** Round 1 onwards is {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
* Winner qualifies for [[Mid_Season_Invitational/2016|Mid Season Invitational 2016]]
